With the **extra-note augmentation omitted**, the in-note beat model gets **precision 91.2, recall 94.3 and F-score 91.3**. With **all augmentation methods**, it gets an **F-score of 92.2** (precision 92.9, recall 93.7). (Table 3, p. 5)

These are note-level F-measure results from Table 3, the ablation study table. (p. 5)

**Notes:**
- The extra-note row has exactly the same numbers (91.2 / 94.3 / 91.3) as the "Use all features" row in the input-feature half of the same table. The paper does not explain this. (p. 5)
- "Extra note" in Table 3 seems to be the method called "Note introduction" in Section 3.1.3. That method adds new notes 12 semitones above or below 0–100% of existing notes. (p. 4)
- The document has no printed page numbers, so I counted pages from the start of the text.
